name: Error Notifier for Slack
author: Dhrumil Kumbhani

sections.description:
Error Notifier for Slack is a powerful and lightweight WordPress plugin that sends real-time Slack notifications whenever a critical WordPress error occurs on your website.

Website errors can cause downtime, lost revenue, poor user experience, and SEO damage. By default, WordPress may send email notifications — but emails can be missed or delayed. This plugin ensures you receive instant alerts directly in your Slack channel, allowing you to take immediate action.

Perfect for developers, agencies, freelancers, SaaS platforms, WooCommerce stores, and mission-critical WordPress websites.

Why You Need Real-Time WordPress Error Monitoring

Critical WordPress errors can:

• Take your website offline
• Break important functionality
• Impact WooCommerce checkout
• Reduce SEO rankings
• Damage user trust
• Cause revenue loss

With Slack-based error notifications, you can detect and resolve issues immediately.

Key Features

Real-Time Slack Notifications

Get instant alerts in your Slack workspace when a critical WordPress error is triggered.

Single Notification Per Error

Prevents notification spam by sending only one alert per unique error occurrence.

Error Resolved Notification

Receive a confirmation message in Slack when the error has been fixed.

Easy Slack Webhook Integration

Simply paste your Slack Incoming Webhook URL in the plugin settings — no coding required.

Lightweight & Performance Optimized

Runs efficiently in the background without slowing down your WordPress site.

Developer Friendly

Useful for debugging, staging environments, and live production monitoring.

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings → Error Notifier.
  3. Enter your Slack webhook URL.
  4. Save settings.
  5. The plugin will automatically monitor critical WordPress errors and send Slack alerts.

Perfect For

• WordPress developers
• WooCommerce store owners
• Digital agencies
• SaaS platforms
• Membership websites
• High-traffic blogs
• Enterprise WordPress environments

SEO & Business Benefits

• Reduce downtime
• Improve website reliability
• Protect SEO rankings
• Prevent revenue loss
• Faster debugging and issue resolution
• Better client reporting for agencies

Compatible With

• Latest WordPress versions
• WooCommerce
• Custom themes
• Page builders
• Most hosting environments
• Production and staging sites

If you rely on WordPress for your business, Error Notifier for Slack is an essential monitoring tool.

Install now and get instant Slack alerts for critical WordPress errors — before your users notice them.
sections.installation:
Follow these steps to install and configure Error Notifier for Slack:

  1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/ or install directly from the WordPress Plugin Repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Error Notifier and enter your Slack webhook URL.
  4. Save changes, and you’ll receive alerts when a critical error occurs!
sections.faq:
How do I set up Slack notifications?

Enter your Slack webhook URL in the plugin settings, and it will send alerts automatically.

Will this plugin send multiple notifications for the same error?

No. It sends only one notification per error until it’s resolved. Once fixed, a single “Error Resolved” alert is sent.

Is this plugin compatible with the latest WordPress version?

Yes! Error Notifier for Slack is tested with the latest WordPress versions to ensure smooth performance.

Does this plugin affect website speed?

Not at all! The plugin is lightweight and runs efficiently in the background.
